lines.beaver_en: Did you get ready for tomorrow's class?
lines.en: Yes, I bought a notebook yesterday.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have pencils and pens?
lines.en: I have pencils. I didn't buy pens.

lines.beaver_en: I'll give you one of my pens. What about your student ID?
lines.en: Thanks. My student ID is in my bag.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Vacation starts next week, right?
lines.learner: 네, 방학 동안 학교에 안 와요.
lines.en: Yes, I won't come to school during vacation.
lines.roman: ne, banghak dongan hakgyoe an wayo.

lines.beaver_en: What are you doing over vacation?
lines.learner: 일주일 동안 부산에 가요. 기차를 타요.
lines.en: I'm going to Busan for a week. I'm taking the train.
lines.roman: iljuil dongan busane gayo. gichareul tayo.

lines.beaver_en: How long does it take to get to Busan?
lines.learner: 세 시간쯤 걸려요. 사진을 많이 찍어요.
lines.en: About three hours. I'll take lots of photos.
lines.roman: se siganjjeum geollyeoyo. sajineul mani jjigeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Sounds great! What will you do after that?
lines.en: I'll study at the library every day. Especially Korean.

lines.beaver: 와, 방학에도 공부해요? 저는 안 해요.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, you study over vacation? I don't.
lines.beaver_roman: wa, banghagedo gongbuhaeyo? jeoneun an haeyo.
lines.en: Yes, the library is open at night too.

lines.beaver_en: How's school life? Is it fun?
lines.en: Classes are fun. The teachers and students are nice.

lines.beaver: 저도 학교가 좋아요. 방학 잘 보내요!
lines.beaver_en: I like school too. Have a good vacation!
lines.beaver_roman: jeodo hakgyoga joayo. banghak jal bonaeyo!
lines.en: Thanks. See you in the classroom after vacation!
